package.name: mowgli_lidar_docking
package.description:
LiDAR-based fine-docking pose estimation for the Mowgli mower (Phase 2). Owns the IDockMatcher contract (D-16), the KinematicICP-backed dock_scan_match production matcher (Plan 02-04), PCD save/load (D-06), the compute_confidence helper for inlier_ratio + RMSE trust-gating (SPEC R-3), and the dock_approach.yaml / dock_scan_meta.yaml flat key=value loaders (D-04 / D-17).
This plan (02-02, Wave 1) ships only the static library + unit tests; the ROS2 node + matcher implementation arrive in Plan 02-04. The library has zero TF / publisher / subscriber code so Architecture Invariant #1 holds.
